mintAuthority.summary: BD's five launch branches mint through collateral-gated BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts. The token owner is renounced. The collateral registry's 4-of-6 Safe governor can authorize additional branch minters without a token-level cap, but its transactions now pass through a verified 259,200-second SaferSafes timelock guard.

controls.capDescription: Registered BorrowerOperations and ActivePool contracts mint only through the protocol's collateralized debt and interest-accounting paths; they cannot register additional minters themselves.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50258421, BoldToken owner() returned the zero address and collateralRegistryAddress() returned 0x7551ebfc8340b7f91874942be9c653733d4fb04f. The pinned token source restricts mint() to registered BorrowerOperations or ActivePool contracts; the launch configuration identifies five collateral branches.

controls.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-22 at Base block 52940932 (2026-10-22T12:13:31Z; hash 0x26a74f3f39341f18ef04d85393409afbdf38fa6d8a406c58bc94257c3e12b6ec), using pinned eth_call, eth_getStorageAt and eth_getCode reads via https://mainnet.base.org. CollateralRegistry governor() and collateralGovernor() still return this Safe; pendingGovernor() and pendingGovernorTimestamp() are zero. The Safe has threshold four, the six listed owners (all with empty code at this pin), VERSION() 1.4.1, and the listed singleton/fallback handler. Its guard slot is SaferSafes 0x4a8dec3abf91f4155855d7111d65197ed26236f7, whose timelockDelay(Safe) returns 259200 seconds (72 hours). This is not an OpenZeppelin TimelockController: there is no getMinDelay() or proposer/executor/canceller role registry. Scheduling requires the Safe's four-owner signature quorum; execution requires valid Safe signatures and an owner caller after the scheduled delay; cancellation currently requires one owner signature, rising after cancellations to at most three and resetting after execution. The complete getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) page is empty with terminal sentinel 0x1; moduleGuard is zero, and the guard's liveness configuration is zero/unconfigured. Verified Safe/guard sources apply checkTransaction before execution, including changes to the guard, delay, modules, owners or fallback handler. Modules would bypass the guard, but none is enabled; the verified compatibility handler exposes signature/callback/read and reverting simulation helpers, not persistent arbitrary Safe execution. Thus the current branch-registration and governor parameter paths pass through the 72-hour guard. The immutable token has no implementation upgrade path; adding minters remains economically unbounded rather than a token-code upgrade. Installation transaction 0x2a66994ddfb5f374cdfa5898a50b81cdc455d3f77462302d581876dc06e20fb2 at block 52836090 (2026-10-20T01:58:47Z) emitted ChangedGuard and GuardConfigured(Safe,259200). The August/September no-delay observation and the October 20 governor-only check did not inspect this guard and are superseded for execution-delay evidence.

review.evidence: Authority refresh reviewed 2026-10-22 at Base block 52940932 (2026-10-22T12:13:31Z; hash 0x26a74f3f39341f18ef04d85393409afbdf38fa6d8a406c58bc94257c3e12b6ec), using pinned reads via https://mainnet.base.org and explorer-verified token, registry, Safe, guard and fallback-handler source. BoldToken owner() remains zero and collateralRegistryAddress() remains 0x7551ebfc8340b7f91874942be9c653733d4fb04f. The token and registry are immutable, but createNewBranch() lets the collateral governor register additional BorrowerOperations and ActivePool minters without a token-level economic ceiling. Both registry governors remain the same 4-of-6 Safe. Unlike the original 2026-08-21 review and the incomplete 2026-10-20 governor-only supersession check, this review checks the Safe's execution extensions: the installed SaferSafes guard enforces timelockDelay(Safe)=259200 seconds, no modules are enabled, and the guard's liveness module is unconfigured. Guard installation/configuration is proven by transaction 0x2a66994ddfb5f374cdfa5898a50b81cdc455d3f77462302d581876dc06e20fb2, not by an inferred governor transfer. The existing five-branch issuance evidence and immutable-upgrade observations retain their original component dates; this refresh establishes current owner/registry/governor/signing and delay facts, not a new full branch census, economic cap, independent key custody, reserve reconciliation or supervision claim. The project docs identify the same Safe; their seven-day debt-limit increase rule is distinct from this Safe-wide 72-hour execution delay. A separate public timelock announcement was not retrievable in the reviewed official blog and indexed X surfaces, so it is not used as evidence.
